steps.message: The bug was caused by `line_position` not being updated correctly for all lines of a chopped word in `rich/_wrap.py`. Specifically, the original code only updated `line_position` for the last line of the word (as yielded by `loop_last`), while `start` was being updated for all other lines. This led to incorrect cursor positioning and caused characters to "disappear" or be misaligned during text wrapping, especially with double-width characters. I replaced the `loop_last` iteration with a range-based loop that iterates through the chopped words from first to last, ensuring that `line_position` is updated for every line and `start` is correctly updated for every line except the first one.
